decisions.reason: The carpentry workshop is more commercially exposed and costlier than core care services, but it still uses the firm's sheltered-workshop and training capabilities well enough to keep this option open for further learning.
Outpatient sociotherapy is very close to the firm's mental-health core, can be scaled flexibly, and remains a low-cost option worth retaining while demand and referral patterns continue to develop.
Counseling for senior living fits the firm's eldercare strengths, requires limited fixed commitment, and looks strategically embedded enough that withdrawal is unlikely.

Meal delivery for seniors is adjacent to the core portfolio and may deepen client relationships, so despite its operational intensity and still-uncertain economics it is reasonable to keep the option open for another year.
